text:
Type: geometric woven throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, contemporary
Materials: textured woven fabric
Colors: ivory, charcoal black, accents of yellow, green, blue, red
Shape: square, Berber-style diamond lattice in dotted lines, scattered dots, small colorful triangles, knife edges, large and plump
Feel: playful, relaxed, light
Goes with: white walls, light wood, rattan, black accents; bohemian or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Abstract Geometric Throw Pillow, 20" x 20", Ivory
product.description: A global-inspired abstract pattern has pops of yellow, blue, green, and red, while soft chenille yarns add a warm coziness. For a different look, it reverses to a solid ivory side. This pillow will freshen up a modern or transitional bedroom. Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 20"L x 20"W, Pillow cover dimensions are measured from seam to seam when cover is laid flat. Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
